text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and I are on our way back
from an
outing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Mmm. Smells like one of these houses is having curry for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Sure does bring back nice

memories—reminds me of my folks'
curry.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It was always chock full of chunky
vegetables and
never failed to fill you
up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Dinner's waiting for me at the
dorm, so I
think I'll save my appetite for
when I get back.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Urgh. I can smell the curry even more
now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... And thanks for being so
understanding!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap runs off, her pace even
quicker than
usual. Is it her empty
stomach driving her
forward? Or did our
trip give her a boost of
energy? It's hard
to tell.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I was thinking the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I gotta eat a lot now for tomorrow's
training!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Actually... Do you mind if I pick where
we eat?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
How did you know? Are you some kinda
psychic?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we stop by the shopping
district to
grab some curry and replenish
our energy.
